contrary_evidence: US private domestic final sales increased 4.9% annualised and Russell 2000 advanced despite Nasdaq losses; the weakness is not uniform.
ECB October employment expectations improved despite lower sentiment; consumer weakness does not prove a broad labour collapse.
BOJ ETF sales are scheduled from January 2027 and may be adjusted or suspended; immediate liquidity impact is not observed.
limitations: GDP is advance quarterly estimate; September income/PCE is a separate monthly vintage and must not be read as quarterly GDP reversal.
No verified borrower-level credit spreads, international investor transaction flows or decomposition of Treasury term premium.
BOJ ETF price effects require observed sales after January 2027; 43-year completion is a mechanical scenario.
World Bank commodity prices are forecasts, not observed spot prices; EIA gas stocks are regional, not global crude data.
Asian intraday price data and later 30 October releases after 05:00 BRT are excluded.

en.title: Global Macro — Strong US growth meets falling real income and a reassessment of AI financing
en.deck: US GDP accelerated to 3.4% annualised while September real disposable income fell; Treasury yields declined, technology shares sold off, and Japan changed its future ETF disposal pace.
